Yesterday major US indices, ex-the Dow Jone Industrial Average, pulled back modestly after the very strong start in the month of August. It continued to be a very busy day of earnings which were broadly positive but tech stocks that reported were under pressure given the high expectations. Oil prices stabilized after a flare up in the Red Sea but that didn’t completely derail hopes for a deal to re-open the Strait.
